name: Read a member's most recent transaction on one account
goal: Look up the member by member number, open their profile, and click the 'View' history link for the account matching the given account_no. The transaction table has no unique row identifier -- each row is just a date/description/amount -- so read the TOP (most recent) row specifically: perform three separate single-cell reads against that top row's Date, Description, and Amount cells, naming each a declared output. If the account has no transactions, call blocked and say so.

inputs.name: account_no
inputs.description: Account number to view transaction history for.

outputs.name: txn_date
outputs.description: Date of the most recent transaction row.

outputs.name: txn_description
outputs.description: Description of the most recent transaction row.

outputs.name: txn_amount
outputs.description: Amount of the most recent transaction row.

business_outcomes.description: The member number does not exist.

known_interstitials.description: Host-maintenance session notice that occasionally interrupts navigation.
